sourceRefs.locator: Collection MHJ035. 10 July 1492, leaders of Girona’s Jewish community, cathedral canons, sale for 300 lliures made under Ferdinand’s expulsion order. Latin parchment in Girona Municipal Archive; related deeds sewn into a 3.6-metre roll of eleven documents.
Opening paragraphs: the last medieval synagogue of Girona was built in 1435 on the site now occupied by the museum and used until 1492.
Chapter 1, Historical Setting, Ferdinand and Isabella. The personal union and the continuing separate political institutions in Castile, Aragon, Catalonia and Valencia.

labels.en: Deed of sale for Girona’s synagogue premises
